description: Send purchases to Meta from gocushy's SERVER instead of relying on the browser pixel, which loses roughly a third of conversions to adblockers and never sees a rebill. Needs the Meta Pixel (dataset) ID and a Conversions API access token from Events Manager — a DATASET-scoped token, never a personal one. Events are deduplicated against the browser pixel by order id, so nothing double-counts. Call with no arguments to read the current setting; the token is write-only and never returned. Pass meta_capi_token: null to switch the rail off. Requires the Trace subscription.

meta_capi_token.description: Conversions API access token from Events Manager (write-only; null clears it)

name: set_conversion_tracking
title: Connect Meta for server-side conversions (Trace)
